why_not_drafted: The 2026-11-19 window carried 13 AI-token slugs and 1 AI+spend slug at slug level, and all 101 window bodies were fetched and read. Every one of the 14 candidates asks for testimony, standing or a named investor, or books a podcast guest. None asks what an AI tool costs, and 11 of the 14 publish no route at all.

The window's single AI+spend hit, the Dataquest India data-centre cover, is capex and power pricing - GPU capacity and facility design - not subscription seat spend. Our dated census cannot answer it without pretending to be an operator.

No new draft is written from this window. The sendable set is carried, not new, and the only honest work left is to keep the carried drafts' figures current and put them in front of George as sends rather than as findings.
